commits.summary: Replay original application fixtures and complete Maven modules (verification pending)
commits.body:
Bind both sides of each caller observation to the original source fixtures and ordered runtime artifacts. Preserve partial outcomes, exception causes and original frames when a later input fails. The complete-module preparation includes generated classes, processed resources and reactor prerequisites. Correct the missing-list oracle and the generated classes used to check SourceFile metadata. The real logging backend is an explicit assumption of the ZT-exec claim.

Checked 25 scope files, four fixture digests against both Git revisions, five runtime companion declarations and their applicable upstream versions. All 27 selected Python groups passed, including the caller-entry and fixture controls. A watcher timing test passed on retry. The queued checks use real spreadsheet, Wire, Guice, profiler, bytecode, reporting, QR, constructor and FTP clients.
